readout_other: open field, novel object recognition and Morris water maze; in vivo LTP and LFP oscillations (PP-DG); western blot (SYP, PSD-95, NR2A, NR2B, GABAAR)
direction_notes: TMAS at both intensities and TUS at 5 W/cm2 improved memory and increased synaptic proteins; TMAS raised LTP and gamma-band measures more than TUS. TUS at 3 W/cm2 reduced SYP, NR2A, NR2B and GABAAR levels relative to sham.
safety_notes: Open-field test showed no anxiety-like effect of stimulation.

exposures.label: Hippocampus, TUS and TMAS (0.3 T magnet) at 3 and 5 W/cm2

timing.protocol_description: 100 Hz pulse repetition frequency and 5% duty cycle, 5 minutes of sonication per mouse, daily for 7 days.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Twenty-four hours after the last stimulation, 8 mice in each group were subjected to in vivo local field potential (LFP) recording, longterm potentiation (LTP) induction from the perforant pathway (PP) to the dentate gyrus (DG) and western blot assay, and the other 8 mice were subjected to the open field test (OFT), the novel object recognition test (NOR) and the Morris water maze test (MWM), as shown in Fig.1(e).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: The stimulation period consisted of 7 days.

source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: Each mouse received 5 minutes of sonication.
